//! Test-only lifetime protocol shared by the Rust native fixtures and Go watchdog.
use nix::libc;
use std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};
use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

static NEXT: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Lifetime {
    pub record: String,
    pub label: String,
    pub pid: i32,
    pub pgid: i32,
}
pub fn quote(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::from("\"");
    for c in value.chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            c if c < ' ' => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}
impl Lifetime {
    pub fn json(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "{{\"Record\":{},\"Label\":{},\"PID\":{},\"PGID\":{}}}",
            quote(&self.record),
            quote(&self.label),
            self.pid,
            self.pgid
        )
    }
}
pub fn lock(file: &File, mode: i32) -> io::Result<()> {
    if unsafe { libc::flock(file.as_raw_fd(), mode) } == 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(io::Error::last_os_error())
    }
}
pub fn held(path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {
    let f = OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(path)?;
    match lock(&f, libc::LOCK_EX | libc::LOCK_NB) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(false),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => Ok(true),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}
// This is the first helper action, before output, blocking, or descendant spawn.
pub fn register(label: &str) -> io::Result<Option<(File, Lifetime)>> {
    let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os("P1_OWNERSHIP") else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let mut admission = match File::open(Path::new(&dir).join("admission")) {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
        Err(e) => return Err(e),
    };
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(1);
    loop {
        match lock(&admission, libc::LOCK_SH | libc::LOCK_NB) {
            Ok(()) => break,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock && Instant::now() < deadline => {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    let mut state = [0; 4];
    admission.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0))?;
    if admission.read_exact(&mut state).is_err() || &state != b"open" {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let pid = std::process::id() as i32;
    let (mut file, record) = loop {
        let name = format!("alive-{}-{}", pid, NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed));
        match OpenOptions::new()
            .read(true)
            .write(true)
            .create_new(true)
            .open(Path::new(&dir).join(&name))
        {
            Ok(f) => break (f, name),
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    };
    lock(&file, libc::LOCK_EX | libc::LOCK_NB)?;
    let lifetime = Lifetime {
        record,
        label: label.to_owned(),
        pid,
        pgid: unsafe { libc::getpgrp() },
    };
    writeln!(file, "{}", lifetime.json())?;
    file.flush()?;
    Ok(Some((file, lifetime)))
}
